why: The heuristic's rung under the defense buff ceiling of ADR 0076, starting from search-21, which was fitted before it. On 200 unseen seeds from 995317, content 4ab506fa, with the ceiling in and the scorer aware of it, search-21 still beats greedy 1.000, stun-first 1.000 and search-19 0.810, and plays the lookahead with lookahead-20 even at 0.500; its own mirror reaches the round cap in every match, restorative_gush healing back the bleeds it casts once both sides sit at 10 defense (journal, 2026-09-24). The ceiling changes what a point of defense is worth, and every weights file was fitted without it. The panel is greedy, search-21 itself and the lookahead with lookahead-20, the one agent that holds search-21, a candidate ranking last if it falls below the start against any: against search-21 the start scores the mirror's 0.5, so a candidate has to beat the set it came from to rank. Stun-first and search-19 are left out: search-21 takes every match from the first and most from the second. The check, off that line, is search-19. The budget is 3 rounds of 8, seed 0: run 22 asked for 4 rounds of 10 and the workflow stopped it at three hours after 38 of its 41 candidates, about 4.7 minutes each against this panel, before it wrote anything; 25 candidates take about two hours and leave the replay on seeds the search never saw inside three. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-21 and lookahead-20 on seeds it never saw without falling below search-21 against greedy or the check. The search scores wins, not length, so whether its own mirror still reaches the cap is read on the hold-out.
